messages:
customer_acme_ops: Hi team — our March invoice (INV-2026-0319) shows 2.1M tokens but our dashboard for account acme-prod shows ~1.2M. Can someone explain the delta? We need a correction or refund if this is wrong.

sara-support: Sorry about that — can you paste the invoice id and a screenshot of the dashboard usage window? Also did you see any API 5xx spikes or retry storms around Mar 12-14?

customer_acme_ops: Invoice INV-2026-0319. Screenshot: https://files.acme.com/screenshots/usage-mar12-14.png. We did see a couple of 502 spikes from the API on Mar 13 02:14 UTC, and our client retried with backoff. We suspect our own retries didn't double-count, dashboard shows no duplicates.

alex-sre: tagging in — can you share a request_id sample or a few message IDs from your client logs? that helps correlate meter events.

customer_acme_ops: Here're a few request ids from our logs: req_8f7a3, req_8f7a4, req_90b2c. Also we log idempotency-key header: x-idempotency: op-42-<timestamp>.

dev-bob: quick check: our ingestion pipeline dedupes based on request_id, but there was a short window on Mar 13 where the replay queue was retried with a duplicate flag due to a consumer offset reset. i'm going to pull the metering event stream.

billing-bot: invoice INV-2026-0319 created for acme-prod — total_charge: $12,360.00 — usage_units: 2,119,842 tokens.

alex-sre: I see the metering stream for acme-prod had ~900k duplicate usage events between 02:13–02:20 UTC on Mar 13. Looks like a replay from kafka consumer group reset. This would explain the +~900k tokens. :eyes:

dev-bob: repro notes: consumer offset reset triggered by deployment job + consumer restart; archived messages were reprocessed because watermark commit wasn't persisted for ~7s. Repro command I ran locally:
```bash
# simulate offset reset causing replay
kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka:9092 --group meter-ingest --reset-offsets --to-earliest --topic usage-events --execute
```

alex-sre: root cause: meter-ingest consumer didn't persist processed offsets when our light-weight checkpoint writer failed under high latency. That writer got a transient 500 from the internal checkpoint service and retried without backoff, causing reprocessing.

maria-finance: From finance POV, we need the exact credit amount and a revrec note to apply to the customer's ledger. What's the corrected token count so I can issue a credit memo?

sara-support: After removing duplicate events the corrected usage is ~1,219,936 tokens. Delta is 899,906 tokens. Our token rate on that plan = $0.012 per 1k tokens. Calculated credit = (899,906 / 1000) * 0.012 = $10.80 (rounded).

maria-finance: Ok I'll prepare a credit memo for $10.80 against INV-2026-0319. RevRec entry: "CR-2026-045: credit for duplicated usage events; root cause: metering ingestion replay; support ticket #5682; refundable amount $10.80." Any approval needed?

sara-support: Please mark as approved by ENG and SRE (alex + dev-bob).

alex-sre: Approved. We've deployed a patch to the checkpoint writer with exponential backoff and stronger persistence checks. Also added an alert on consumer lag + commit-failures.

dev-bob: Deployed fix at 2026-03-15T04:30Z. Added idempotency check in metering ingest: we now dedupe on request_id AND idempotency-key where present.

maria-finance: Credit memo created and applied: CreditMemo CM-2026-902 applied to INV-2026-0319 for $10.80. Ledger note: "revrec: CR-2026-045 / CM-2026-902 — duplicate token credit per support ticket #5682; applied 2026-03-16."

billing-bot: Credit applied to INV-2026-0319 — remaining_balance: $0.00 — note: CM-2026-902.

sara-support: Customer notified with summary and root cause. Message sent: "We identified a metering replay that produced duplicate usage events. We've applied a $10.80 credit and deployed a fix to prevent recurrence. Sorry for the disruption."

customer_acme_ops: Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround and the transparency. We'll watch the Apr billing. Also please share the mitigation so our client-side retry logic can be tuned if needed.

alex-sre: Shared mitigation checklist: (1) server-side idempotency is enforced, (2) monitor commit failures > 0 for meter-ingest, (3) set client retry jitter/backoff and preserve idempotency-key header.

dev-bob: follow-up: we'll backfill monitoring dashboard with a new tile: "meter-ingest-duplicate-rate" and add an automated reconciliation job that compares dashboard aggregate vs invoice nightly.

maria-finance: For RevRec/accounting, if legal needs more detail we have: root_cause = "kafka consumer offset reset replayed archived usage events"; corrective_action = "applied credit CM-2026-902; deployed checkpoint persistence fix; added monitoring and dedupe by idempotency key".

customer_acme_ops: Got it. Closing on our side once Apr invoice reconciles. Thanks all.

sara-support: closing ticket in Zendesk: ZD-5682 -> resolved.

billing-bot: ticket ZD-5682 marked resolved and credit logged.
